import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def fetch_page(start=0):
    # Using %20 for spaces in the query to avoid control-character issues
    query = 'all:multimodal%20OR%20all:RAG'
    url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start={start}&max_results=25&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
    return web_fetch(url=url)

# XML namespaces used by arXiv
ns = {
    'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom',
}

def is_relevant(title, summary):
    text = (title + ' ' + summary).lower()
    # Multimodal indicators
    multi_indicators = ['multimodal', 'vision', 'visual', 'image', 'video', 'audio', 
                       'speech', 'crossmodal', 'cross-modal', 'vlm', 'vision-language',
                       'vision language', 'graph', 'document', 'table', 'chart']
    # RAG indicators
    rag_indicators = ['rag', 'retrieval augmented generation', 'retrieval-augmented generation',
                     'retrieval augmented', 'retrieval-augmented', 'retrieval-based',
                     'retrieval-based generation']
    has_multi = any(ind in text for ind in multi_indicators)
    has_rag = any(ind in text for ind in rag_indicators)
    return has_multi and has_rag

papers = []
start = 0
max_pages = 10  # safety limit

while len(papers) < 5 and start < max_pages * 25:
    resp = fetch_page(start)
    if resp.get('status') != 200:
        print(f'Failed to fetch page starting at {start}')
        break
    
    root = ET.fromstring(resp['content'])
    for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
        title_el = entry.find('atom:title', ns)
        summary_el = entry.find('atom:summary', ns)
        updated_el = entry.find('atom:updated', ns)
        id_el = entry.find('atom:id', ns)
        
        # Get the HTML link
        link_el = None
        for link in entry.findall('atom:link', ns):
            if link.get('rel') == 'alternate' and link.get('type') == 'text/html':
                link_el = link.get('href')
                break
        
        if None in (title_el, summary_el, updated_el, id_el, link_el):
            continue
        
        title = title_el.text.strip()
        summary = ' '.join(summary_el.text.strip().split())
        updated = updated_el.text.strip()[:10]  # YYYY-MM-DD
        arxiv_id = id_el.text.strip()
        
        if not is_relevant(title, summary):
            continue
        
        papers.append({
            'title': title,
            'summary': summary,
            'date': updated,
            'link': link_el,
            'arxiv_id': arxiv_id
        })
        if len(papers) >= 5:
            break
    
    start += 25

# Build markdown table
def build_table(papers):
    lines = [
        "| Rank | Title | Date | Summary (truncated) | Link |",
        "|------|-------|------|---------------------|------|"
    ]
    for i, p in enumerate(papers, 1):
        short_sum = ' '.join(p['summary'].split()[:12])  # first ~12 words
        short_sum = short_sum[:150].replace('|', '\\|')  # escape pipes
        lines.append(f"| {i} | {p['title']} | {p['date']} | {short_sum} | [Link]({p['link']}) |")
    return '\n'.join(lines)

table_md = build_table(papers[:5])
with open('papers.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(table_md)

print(f'Successfully wrote {len(papers[:5])} papers to papers.md')
